HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Chel.]
Hiccough.
Belching. θ Influenza. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Liver complaint.
Empty, acid or bilious eructations.
Constant eructation of wind. θ Affection of liver. θ Cardialgia.
Heartburn ; with eructations.
Qualmishness, relieved by belching.
Nausea : after belching ; with vomiturition ; with heat in stomach ; before stool ; causes great bodily heat.
Great nausea succeeds the violent pain, then eructations follow, which relieve pain if she lies down and does not move. θ Prosopalgia.
Nausea and retching during an attack of anxiety.
Nausea in hepatitis and vomiting of pregnancy.
Retching, followed by sour vomiting. θ Hepatic typhus.
Nausea and bilious vomiting. θ Sick headache.
Relieved by belching : short breath and anxiety. θ Gastralgia.
Retching during bilious eructation.
Retching and vomiting either transient or permanent ; sometimes in spells ; always with distressing constriction in gastric region.
Bilious vomiting.
Vomiting of tough, or acid or greenish mucus.
Persistent vomiting ; nothing can be retained but water nearly boiling.
Bilious vomiting, giddiness in head, nausea, choking during bilious eructations. θ Bilious vomiting.
Acute gastric or intestinal catarrh preceding pneumonia.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Chel.]
Feeling of anguish in pit of stomach. θ Hepatic typhus.
Scrobiculum sensitive on pressure. θ Mental affections. θ Acute rheumatism.
Awakened by a sense of tightness in scrobiculum.
Pressure in scrobiculum on stooping.
Pressure in scrobiculum, with oppression of chest and difficult breathing. θ Hepatic typhus.
Persistent pains in scrobiculum ; < by motion ; > by eructation. θ Cardialgia.
Griping, pressing pain in and below scrobiculum < from touch.
Throbbing, cramplike pain in pit of stomach ; feeling of anguish, difficulty of breathing.
Constriction, tension and sensitiveness in pit of stomach and right hypochondrium. θ Hepatic affections. θ Dyspepsia.
A sharp painful stitch in pit of stomach, which extends through to back.
Stitches in pit of stomach.
Aching, gnawing pain in stomach, with a sense of constriction ; < from pressure ; > from eating.
Sensation as of an animal wriggling in epigastric region.
Pressure, with distension of stomach.
Constant aching pain in stomach ; > after food. θ Indigestion.
Pressure and oppression in stomach, drawing up into chest.
Oppressive or cramplike throbbing in pit of stomach, and breathing with anguish.
Constriction, pinching, squeezing pain in stomach ; > on drawing up limbs and lying on left side.
Gnawing, grinding pain in stomach ; > from eating. θ Cardialgia.
Digging pain in region of stomach.
Cutting in stomach ; < from pressure and yawning ; sour after eating.
Sensation of heat in region of stomach and slight griping.
Cold sensation in stomach.
Nothing can be kept on stomach but hot water.
Gastralgia.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Chel.]
Stitches in region of liver.
Shooting, stitching pains through liver to back ; crampy pain in inner angle of scapula. θ Congestion of liver.
Pains from region of liver, shooting towards back and shoulder.
Spasmodic pain in region of liver. θ Bilious vomiting.
Pressive pain in region of liver.
Pain in region of liver, extending quickly downward across navel into intestines. θ Biliary colic.
Biliary calculi ; chill ; intense pain in region of gall bladder, vomiting and clay-colored stools.
Pain in region of liver and spleen.
Pain in region of liver > by eating. θ Hepatic fever.
Dull throbbing in region of liver.
Region of liver painful on pressure. θ Pneumonia.
Liver enlarged, indurated, sensitive on pressure.
Fatty liver, border of which extends to navel, with icterus.
A kind of numbness in muscles of hepatic region and in whole right side of neck, face and head.
Contused pain in right hypochondriac region.
Chronic pain in liver.
Right hypochondrium and scrobiculum cordis tense and painful to pressure. θ Acute rheumatism. θ Liver affections.
Left hypochondrium and scrobiculum cordis sensitive to pressure. θ Mental disturbance.
Sense of fulness, pressure and tension in right hypochondrium. θ Liver complaint.
Cutting pains and stitches in hypochondrium, with sense of constriction like a cord.
Clothes feel too tight, causing anxiety from accumulation of wind in throat pressing on diaphragm.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Chel.]
Griping in umbilical region ; then cutting in abdomen and across right lumbar region, extending to back.
Severe pain around umbilical region.
Spasmodic contraction of umbilicus, with transient nausea.
Pain across umbilicus, as if abdomen was constricted by a string.
Painful pressure over umbilicus.
Retraction of umbilicus, great heat of body, nausea ; violent pressing, returning periodically, > from wine.
Coldness and pressing mostly below umbilical region ; body cold.
Constrictive sensation in hypogastrium, just before passage of turbid urine.
Spasmodic drawing pains in both inguinal regions.
Pinching pain in left groin.
Colic, with nausea and retraction of navel.
Griping, extending towards chest and back ; > by passing flatus.
Cutting in bowels immediately after a meal.
Jerking, cutting in intestines as from knives without relief from a thin stool.
Burning in bowels.
Pain and rumbling in cecal region.
Rumbling, gurgling, pinching and cutting in bowels.
Rumbling followed by diarrhœa.
Abdomen distended, feels full and uncomfortable. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Abdominal plethora. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Liver affections.
Abdomen sensitive to pressure. θ Hepatic typhus.
Pot-belly. θ Worms.
Ascites ; urine scanty and yellow ; palms yellow.
Contraction of abdominal walls.
Swelling and ulceration of inguinal glands. θ Suppressed gonorrhœa. θ Secondary syphilis.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Chel.]
Frequent discharge of flatus.
Diarrhœa, with pain under inner and lower angle of right shoulder blade. θ Pregnancy.
Diarrhœa without pain, without urging.
Fluid feces, often escape unexpectedly. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Chronic diarrhœa with liver affection.
Stools : brown watery, white watery ; green mucous ; thin, pasty, bright yellow ; pasty, light grey ; like rice-water, tinged yellow ; pale, slimy ; mucous diarrhœa, at night ; constipated, like sheep's dung ; like dry clay ; involuntary ; white, clay colored.
Yellow watery passages containing flakes of mucus. θ Hepatic typhus.
Slimy, greyish-green diarrheic stool, comes on involuntarily. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Stools quite white like thick pap, in children. θ Cough.
Hard, white stools, every 4 or 5 days. θ Prosopalgia.
Grey stool, with slight coloring of urine and absence of icteric symptoms.
Flakes, strings, gelatinous lumps ; deficiency of biliary coloring matter in stools. θ Diarrhœa.
Diarrhœa and constipation alternately.
Constipation. θ Hepatitis.
Hard and whitish-yellow stools. θ Mental affection.
Stool bright yellow and consistent. θ Cough.
Stool very hard and difficult, with pains in anus in consequence.
Some blood follows stool.
With stool a sensation as if anus was contracted.
Round worms. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Before and after stool rumbling in abdomen.
Burning and cutting in rectum, with constriction of anus, alternating with itching in anus.
Periodic straining and pressing on rectum as if before a stool, without result.
Drawing in rectum.
Crawling and itching in rectum and on perineum.
Sticking and itching in anus. θ Hemorrhoids.
